  • Constructor Details

    • Saints

      public Saints(String name, String portraitKey, int strength, int wisdom, int dexterity, int stamina, int perception, int hireCost, int upKeep)
      Constructor for Apostle's. To be generated through market which pull's on each respective class for base additions. Market -> Executioner -> Apostle's. Will build this way to so itterate's over game state. Longer game goes on, better stat's for Apostle's in market
      Parameters:
      name - Name for Apostle
      portraitKey - Portrait of the Apostle generated in market
      strength - Strength for Apostle, int 0-20 which is modified in class get as (strength - 10 / 2)
      wisdom - Wisdom for Apostle, int 0-20 which is modified in class get as (wisdom - 10 / 2)
      dexterity - Dexterity for Apostle, int 0-20 which is modified in class get as (dexterity - 10 / 2)
      stamina - maxStamina and currentStamina for the apostle
      perception - Perception for Apostle, serve's as the chance to find Item's
      hireCost - Cost to hire the Apostle, (500 to 1000 faith) - > calculation is ((each stat - 10 / 2) * 25) + 500.
      upKeep - Cost per expedition for apostle, (-240 to 240) -> calculation is (each stat - 10 / 2) * 12
